title: First Light / Whispers Before Dawn
theme: A missing ledger line pulls the player from Newport Harbor into counting-house pressure, tavern whisper culture, harbor rumors, and pre-Revolution unrest.

objectives.text: Make landfall at Newport Harbor and get your bearings.
Find Edrin Vale at the Counting House.
Ask the dockworkers, merchant row, or notice board about the missing ledger line.
Bring the missing-line rumor to Bess Armitage at the Tavern/Inn.
Choose a next lead: Edrin, the wharf, or the rear gate.
Look for the lantern signal at the wharf.
Secure a trusted contact before the rumor spreads.
Keep the missing line quiet until dawn.

opening_arc.hook_to_continue: Edrin becomes a named contact and asks the player to keep the missing line quiet until dawn.

progression.reward: Resolve +5 for following the tavern whisper and a named contact hook with Edrin Vale
